Review the exact committed Testcenter rewrite change ad92a0864ac56987a4896fd5770abab0c0c9b271..af35827f901f42c5c47a91c14a16be0f0953d1d8. Your dimension is security-review. Trace introduced authorization, token handling, scope/cache isolation, stale asynchronous data, injection and data exposure risks. Report only evidence-backed vulnerabilities introduced by this patch, not generic hardening or known Original defects already contained by the rewrite.
Inspect the actual diff and source. The worktree is pinned to HEAD. Original is read-only at /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-20/en/work/testcenter-original (eedae41840cbe90e5547c0211da818bdf620f5aa). Preserve stronger tenant/workspace/group boundaries and existing browser, deadline, privacy and 470kB budget gates.
Establish scope from the actual diff, checked-in documentation and commit-matched evidence. Incremental checks do not prove whole-project parity. Verify whether older open handoff issues remain open; report concrete introduced defects rather than merely restating unfinished project scope.
Historical validation receipts: /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/outputs/testcenter-native-monitor-ui-20261028.json and /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/work/native-monitor-ui-cache-env-proof/result.json. Match each claim to its actual commit, tree, scenario and result. Historical success cannot qualify a newer HEAD; historical failures may have been fixed. Do not claim current CI success without current matching evidence.
Return requested JSON only. Findings need a tracked repository-relative path, exact current line, evidence and remedy. Use request_changes for any unresolved substantive defect, inconclusive if review could not complete, unknown for missing signal evidence. Explain what you actually verified and the remaining limits.
Coverage: inspect the full changed-file inventory, then the relevant source/diff of every path in your dimension. Classify verbatim Original copies versus adaptation changes and novel code. Use the available review time to complete coverage rather than ending early solely because the port is large. Older findings matter when they concern this patch; unrelated unfinished Goal work does not itself constitute an introduced defect. Never infer a pass from the absence of findings if coverage remains incomplete.

Before your final report, create coverage.json in your private artifact directory: an array with one record per changed path, containing path, disposition (reviewed_diff, verified_source_copy, deleted, out_of_dimension, or remaining), and a concrete evidence/basis string. Verify this inventory against git diff --name-only BASE HEAD. Verbatim Source assets may be established by exact hash comparison plus inspection of how they enter the app; adaptations require their actual diff and trust-boundary/call-site inspection. Explain every out_of_dimension classification. Continue the review until all relevant paths have been inspected; do not end early merely because some paths remain. If coverage still cannot be completed, preserve an inconclusive signal and name the actual remaining files.

Source repository (read-only, use absolute paths or git -C): /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-20/en/work/testcenter-local-review-af35827f901f. First read its AGENTS.md. Private writable artifact directory: /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/work/local-merge-review-af35827f/security-review-artifacts. All other source paths, including Original, remain read-only. Do not seek expanded permissions. Save any required scan artifacts in this directory. Current validation receipt: /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/work/round11-af-validation-receipt.json.
I’ll inspect the repository guidance and complete changed-file inventory first, then trace the security-sensitive changes against Original and the commit-matched validation evidence.

The patch adds a native monitor and changes one server-side roster boundary. The current receipt reports a successful local build at 469.17 kB, but its CI run was still in progress; earlier browser evidence belongs to older commits.

The monitor’s request and dialog paths explicitly retire on access or route changes, and Booklet caching is keyed to the current access object. I’m checking the remaining adapted views and their call sites, including the older handoff issues, before finalizing coverage.
